borders.label: 边框 1 - Border 1
borders.description: Divider Light (`#DADCE0`): Hairline dividers between email rows on thread view; omitted in inbox list (rows separated by whitespace only).

borders.label: 边框 3 - Border 3
borders.description: Text Link (`#1A73E8`): Blue hyperlinks in email body — slightly deeper blue than Google Blue.

borders.label: 边框 4 - Border 4
borders.description: Gmail's iOS app is a Material You inbox that inherits Google's multicolor brand DNA while staying clean enough to spend all day in. The canvas is pure white (`#FFFFFF`) on light mode — the screen feels like paper, deliberately unbranded, so the *contents* of your inbox (subjects, snippets, labels) carry the visual information. The only structural saturation comes from the Gmail red (`#D93025`) reserved almost exclusively for the Compose FAB (the floating plus button bottom-right), the Gmail logotype, and destructive states like "Delete forever". Outside of that single red accent, the UI leans on Google's 4-color palette — Red `#EA4335`, Yellow `#FBBC04`, Green `#34A853`, Blue `#4285F4` — applied sparingly on category chips, avatar fallbacks, and Smart Reply affordances.

borders.label: 边框 5 - Border 5
borders.description: Surface Light (`#F6F8FC`): Section card backgrounds, quoted reply blocks, tonal buttons.

panels.title: 面向真实界面片段
panels.body: 按钮、输入、卡片和间距样例保持克制，便于比较不同主题的系统性差异。

do: 建议：Use pure white ({#FFFFFF}) as the light canvas — content is the color, not the chrome。
建议：Position the Compose FAB bottom-right at 16pt from edges — never inline, never centered。
建议：Use Gmail red ({#D93025}) ONLY for the Compose FAB and destructive actions — it's sacred。
建议：Apply the Google 4-color palette to avatars, category chips, Smart Reply chips — never to structural UI。
建议：Use Google Sans for titles/buttons, Roboto for body/metadata — don't mix within a block。
dont: 避免：use pure black {#000000} on dark mode — use {#202124} (Google's standard)。
避免：color the inbox chrome — the FAB is the only chromatic element; everything else is grayscale。
避免：use circles for the Compose FAB — it's a 16pt squircle, not a pure circle。
避免：show red anywhere outside of destructive actions and the FAB。
避免：mix Google Sans and Roboto in the same text block — clear division。
